meta.warning: Read this section as a modelling tool, not as reported results. No operator publishes fully-loaded cost per mile, and none of the figures below are disclosed. Every value is an estimate assembled on this site from vehicle platforms, published hardware-cost claims and local wage and energy levels, then run through the same arithmetic as the calculator on the economics page. They are starting points to argue with. Change them.
meta.baseline: Where a company-specific basis was not available the value falls back to the published default on /economics/, so an unedited column is the site's generic operator, not a company-specific claim.

waymo.name: Waymo
waymo.note: Jaguar I-Pace platform with a fifth-generation kit, the most expensive combination on the map. Highest utilisation and the deepest remote-assistance automation, so the operator ratio is the most favourable assumption here.

zoox.name: Zoox
zoox.note: Purpose-built bidirectional vehicle with no steering wheel, manufactured in-house. Capex is a single figure rather than vehicle-plus-kit, and low fleet count means fixed costs spread badly.

baidu-apollo-go.name: Baidu Apollo Go
baidu-apollo-go.note: RT6 built to a stated sub-$30,000 target, the lowest hardware bill in the industry, against Chinese fare levels that are a fraction of US ride-hail.

pony-ai.name: Pony.ai
pony-ai.note: Seventh-generation kit at a stated ~70% cost reduction, on Chinese OEM platforms and Chinese operating costs.

weride.name: WeRide
weride.note: GXR platform across a wider geographic spread than any peer, which raises depot and support cost per vehicle relative to a single dense market.

tesla.name: Tesla
tesla.note: Camera-only stack on a mass-produced consumer vehicle: by far the lowest capex assumption on the map, and the one most dependent on an unproven claim about supervision ratios.

may-mobility.name: May Mobility
may-mobility.note: Fixed-route and microtransit rather than open ride-hail, on Sienna platforms. Shorter service hours and municipal contracts rather than metered fares.

motional.name: Motional
motional.note: IONIQ 5 platform built on a Hyundai line, relaunched at small scale in Las Vegas through Uber.
